translations.text: Good is the craft of learning: it makes a king of a poor man, it makes a noble of a landless outcast, it makes a well-born man of a low-born one, it makes a wise man of a fool.
Good is its beginning, better is its end; it is honoured in this world, precious in the other world; it is not wretched at its end, that is, in bringing heaven to the soul.
Hard is the craft of the warrior's life. It is not illustrious, and its fire is [?].
Its [?] is busy and fleeting, that is, its living are pierced with wounds, its dead are in hell.
A father does not hand it down to his son. Woe to the one whose craft is the warrior's life, unless repentance comes.
